# WAPT Elite Training Program by Cryptonic Area

> A practical, live mentor-led, beginner-friendly web application penetration testing (WAPT) course from Cryptonic Area, India. 6 to 6.5 weeks, 20 sessions of 1 to 1.5 hours, hands-on labs, OWASP Top 10, bug bounty methodology, professional reporting, a completion certificate and an internship opportunity for top performers. Taught online in Hindi-English (Hinglish). Fee: INR 4,999 one-time.

Key facts (verify live on the course page before quoting price or seats):
- Level: beginner, starts from zero. Only basic computer knowledge is needed.
- Format: 100% online, recorded classes plus live mentor-led doubt-clearing sessions.
- Batch size: 45 seats. Certificate after the final online assessment.
- Tools: Burp Suite, Nmap, SQLMap, OWASP ZAP, Metasploit, Nikto, Wireshark, AI tools.
- No job guarantee. Sales are final (duplicate-payment exception within 48 hours).
- Mentor: AkashDas Barman (M.Tech, CEH, WAPT, NPT, CNSP).
